answer_1.quote: ...we task the two best-performing open-weight and closed-source models ... with answering three different types of prompts aimed at: i) definition generation, ii) free-form explanation, iii) example generation...
answer_1.outputs: generated dictionary-style definitions, free-form explanations, and example sentences for target words in context

answer_2.quote: ...we primarily rely on lexical overlap between generated and gold definitions to extract model answers... we performed additional experiments computing perplexity-based scores for a subset of open models...

answer_4.quote: ...We task the two best‑performing ... with answering three different types of prompts... For each item, the annotator has four options: equally correct, better than gold, worse than gold, wrong... In the free explanation task ... options include good, bad and borderline... In the example generation task ... four options could be selected: yes, yes but same pattern, no, borderline...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate generated definitions, free-form explanations, and example sentences using predefined categories (e.g., equally correct/better/worse/wrong for definitions; good/bad/borderline for explanations; yes/yes but same pattern/no/borderline for examples).
